pattern: WAI-ARIA APG grid (as Calendar): one table role=grid per month with a single roving tab stop across all months; every day cell names its date and kind.

aria.value: Full date and kind, for example "Thursday, January 1, 2026, holiday: New Year's Day" or "..., working day (changed): Stocktaking"

keyboard.action: Previous / next day (mirrored in RTL); pages when leaving the visible months.
Same weekday of the previous / next week.
First / last day of the week.
Same day of the previous / next month; with Shift, the previous / next year.
Emits aui-day-select; in edit mode also toggles working / non-working and announces the change.
Previous button, next button, then the focused day (one tab stop for all months).

focus: One roving tab stop across all visible months; moving past the visible months pages them. Focus stays on a toggled day after an edit.
notes: Day kinds are never conveyed by color alone: each cell names its kind, holidays have a bottom bar, changed days a dashed outline, and holidays are listed as text.
Edits are announced through the shared live region ("January 6, 2026 is now a non-working day.").
knownCaveats: Screen-reader behavior has not yet been manually verified with NVDA, JAWS, and VoiceOver.
